summary_1line: Skanda battles Indra, generates the warrior Visakha from the thunderbolt wound, then refuses Indra’s throne and is anointed commander of the celestial armies.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra hurls his thunderbolt into Skanda’s side, and from the blazing wound emerges the warrior Visakha holding a club.
Flames burst from Skanda’s mouth and sweep across the battlefield, burning the celestial army and their mounts.
Skanda stands crowned beneath a golden umbrella while gods, rishis, and apsaras surround him as he is anointed commander of the celestial hosts.
